title: The 2-part of the Bloch-Kato conjecture, and indivisibility results, for $K_2$ of some elliptic curves
summary: For certain integers $u$, we investigate the 2-part of the Bloch-Kato conjecture for $L(E_u,2)$, where $E_u: y^2=x(x+1)(x+u^2)$ is part of a (twisted) Legendre family that is 2-isogenous to a family studied by Boyd. For this, we first work out the corresponding 2-parts of the Tamagawa factors and Galois invariants. Then we give an explicit description of the 2-torsion in the Selmer group $H_f^1(\mathbb{Q},E_u[2^\infty](-1))$. We construct a specific element in the kernel of the tame symbol for $K_2$ on an integral model of $E_u$, with non-vanishing real and 2-adic regulators. Using…
